fields.name: seoTitle
fields.label: Meta Title (SEO)
fields.description: Shown in the browser tab and search results — not on the page itself. The large heading visitors see at the top is Headline, under Hero.

fields.name: seoDescription
fields.label: Meta Description (SEO)
fields.description: Used for search results and social-sharing previews.

fields.name: headline
fields.label: Headline
fields.description: The first line of the main heading.

fields.name: headlineAccent
fields.label: Headline — accent line
fields.description: Rendered on a new line, in cyan. Leave blank for a single-line heading.

fields.name: ledeNote
fields.label: Intro note (small print)
fields.description: Short line under the intro, e.g. 'First built on AEM and EDS workflows'. Leave blank to hide.

fields.name: video
fields.label: Video placeholder
fields.description: Stand-in shown until a real overview film exists.

fields.name: approach
fields.label: Approach
fields.description: The light section. Numbers (01, 02 …) are generated automatically.

fields.name: headingLine2
fields.label: Heading — second line
fields.description: Rendered on a new line. Leave blank for a single-line heading.

fields.name: workflow
fields.label: Workflow
fields.description: The numbered delivery stages. Numbers are generated automatically.

fields.name: headingLine2
fields.label: Heading — second line
fields.description: Rendered on a new line. Leave blank for a single-line heading.

fields.name: command
fields.label: Command badge
fields.description: Monospace badge shown on the right, e.g. /draft-req.

fields.name: headingAccent
fields.label: Heading — accent line
fields.description: Rendered on a new line, in cyan.

fields.name: seo
fields.label: Site Identity & SEO
fields.description: Site-wide identity. The Site Name is the wordmark shown in the header and footer; Description is the default for search results and social shares.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Site Name
fields.description: The wordmark shown next to the logo in the header and footer.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Default Meta Description (SEO)
fields.description: Default description for search results and social-sharing previews when a page does not provide its own.

fields.name: siteOwner
fields.label: Site Owner
fields.description: Used in the footer copyright line.

fields.name: logo
fields.label: Logo
fields.description: Shown next to the Site Name in the header and footer.

fields.name: nav
fields.label: Primary Navigation
fields.description: Links in the header. These are in-page anchors, so use values like #approach.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link URL
fields.description: An in-page anchor (#approach) or a full URL.

fields.name: headerCta
fields.label: Header Button
fields.description: The pill-shaped call to action on the right of the header.

fields.name: tagline
fields.label: Tagline
fields.description: Short line under the wordmark in the footer.

description.value: References another document, used as a foreign key
